films.title: The Substance
films.review:
My favourite shot is the moment Sue and Elisabeth look at each other, because it was the first time while watching that I understood they are not the same person, and maybe the first time Sue and Elisabeth understood it too.

We like to think the soul, or consciousness, or memory is what makes us who we are. As long as I am still myself, we let ourselves damage the body and chase beauty too far. But it is the embodied experience that ends up making us, especially now, in the age of AI. Even with all of my memories loaded into it, it is not me. I am me, inside my body.

The film uses an extreme torture of the body to remind us that anxiety about beauty is bad, and that as things move on and we keep learning we can find a gentler middle. The overdone ending is a reminder that in a post-feminist age we should stop shaming ourselves for not being confident, since none of us is about to turn into a monster and spray blood across a stage.

films.review_zh:
我最喜欢的一个镜头是苏和伊丽莎白对视的那一刻，因为那是我在观看电影时第一次认识到他们不是同一个人，也许也是苏和伊丽莎白第一次意识到他们不是同一个人。我们总是认为灵魂或者意识、记忆决定了我们是谁。既然我还是我自己，于是我们允许自己去伤害自己的身体，过度追求美丽。但是我们的具身体验最终塑造了我们，特别是在今天AI的时代。哪怕AI被输入了我的全部记忆，它也不是我；我才是我，在我的身体之中。

作者用一种极致的对身体的折磨提醒我们，为美丽焦虑虽然是不好的，但是随着时代进步以及不断地学习，我们也是可以学会去找到一种温和的中庸状态的。过于夸张的结尾其实是在提醒我们，在后女权时代，就不要为自己没有那么自信而陷入羞辱循环中了，毕竟我们还是不会弄得自己在舞台上变身怪物、大肆喷血的

films.review: What moves me in First Cow is how deftly it shows time burying us. For most of us, while we are young, time does not wreck us, does not set the body aching. It covers us in dust. We get fixed at some point, and finitude gives off an infinite light, and that moment is also the moment we are buried. Everything after it is a footnote, a commentary, a postscript or history.

films.title: El Sur
films.review:
This film brings Janet Planet to mind. The insights into a child's interiority and lived experience are remarkably delicate, and they require not just a profound attunement to life and emotion but the formal mastery to transmute that sensibility into cinematic language.

Janet Planet captures the density of time: that sticky, seemingly interminable stretch of summer. Boredom, in itself, is a quiet romanticism. You have not yet learned to measure your existence against objectives.

El Sur, on the other hand, dwells in spatial darkness, hunting for a source of light under constraint, knowing you can keep living as long as there is any light at all. It is in this exact drift that we grasp how irreducibly complex people are, and slowly become more whole ourselves.

films.title: Talk to Me
films.review:
Talk to Me shows that A24 has settled into its own taste in picking films: small, precise, repressed, arty. Anyone can make a seance horror film, but A24's is not like the others. It is as if you asked them for scrambled eggs with tomato and they insist on adding pepper and basil.

Every setup pays off cleverly, though the logic does not quite hold, like a beautifully made puzzle box that forgets a smart player will simply smash it open to get at what is inside.
films.genre: horror film, thriller film
films.review_zh:
从《回应我》可以看出，现在的A24已经成功地形成了自己的一套选片口味：小巧精致，闷骚文艺。大家都可以拍笔仙类的恐怖片，但a24就是和其他人拍的不一样。就像是你让他做一份西红柿炒蛋，他也偏要加上胡椒粉和罗勒。
伏笔全部得到很巧妙的照应，但逻辑上却不完全自洽，就像一个设计精巧的机关盒，忽略了聪明的玩家会直接把它摔碎来获得核心里的东西。
